name: Release Checklist
description: Prepare a public OSS release with verification, maintainer approval, release-note drafting, and audit logging.

steps.name: Check version and changelog
steps.description: Confirm the planned version, changelog entry, and release scope are aligned.

steps.name: Run local verification
steps.description: Represent the local test, workflow validation, and public scan checks that must pass before release.

steps.name: Maintainer approval
steps.description: Pause before drafting release notes or publishing anything.

approval.prompt: Review the verification result, changelog, and release scope before approving release-note drafting.

steps.name: Draft release notes through mock adapter
steps.description: Simulate creating a release-note draft without calling a hosting provider.

steps.name: Record release audit
steps.description: Record the approved release scope, verification result, and mock release-note action.
